content: Excellent embedded course repos share: one isolated project per assignment, a root index, self-contained per-lab READMEs, a shared starter template, and CI that builds/tests each project. Purdue ECE362 proton-labs uses one directory per lab, a root index README, and a shared template.zip; Cornell ECE4760 project pages include BOM, pin map, schematics, code link, test results, and AI-use disclosure. Most course repos stop at code + README and lack reproducible evidence.
